name: Woomelang Silo Art

facts.claim: Woomelang has a miniature silo art trail of eight small field-bin murals scattered around the town, not one large silo
The murals celebrate endangered species of the Mallee
Located in Woomelang, Mallee region, western Victoria (67 Brook St); carpark and picnic area

ticketUrl_note: no single steward; trail promoted by Visit Wimmera Mallee (not a ticketed site)
access_note: Not a large silo mural: eight mini field-bin murals; consider renaming/bio accordingly. Visit Wimmera Mallee lists Woomelang under the Silo Art Trail.

name: National Wool Museum

facts.claim: Museum tells the story of wool, fibre and textiles, with contemporary exhibitions and public programs
Housed in the former Dennys, Lascelles woolstore at 26 Moorabool Street, Geelong
Opened in 1988 as part of the Australian Bicentenary celebrations

name: You Yangs Regional Park

facts.claim: Granite peaks rise abruptly from the flat plains west of Melbourne, about an hour away
Flinders Peak is the highest point in the You Yangs, with views out to Melbourne and Geelong
Over 50 km of trails for walkers, horse riders and mountain bikers; nine picnic areas
Main ridge about 9 km long, up to 343 m, 22 km north of Geelong
